subcategory_text: Technical measures implemented to manage data processing are tested and assessed.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: CA-2 (Control Assessments), SI-6 (Software and Information Integrity)
ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A.8.8 (Technical vulnerability management), A.8.29 (Security testing in development and acceptance)
implementation_examples: Test and assess the technical measures that manage data processing against their intended behaviour and privacy objectives
Document the testing methodology, scope, frequency, and acceptance criteria
assessment_objectives: Determine whether technical data-processing measures are tested against requirements
Determine whether testing scope, frequency, and criteria are documented
Determine whether test results feed into improvement actions
Determine whether independence of the tester is adequate to the risk
